verdict.rationale: LibreChat documents a first-party 'Scheduled Chats' feature page, which points to its own capability for running chats on a schedule rather than only on demand. The evidence is only the page title, so how autonomous, background-run or recurring these automations are is not shown. Missing for 10: details of scheduling (recurring vs one-off), confirmation that runs execute unattended in the background with agents/tools, trigger types beyond time, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
